admission.justification: Realized across dashboard/.oxlintrc.json, dashboard/package.json, code_quality/scope.py, and code_quality/scope_reporting.py and guarded by mcp/tests/test_code_quality_dashboard_lint_scope.py, preventing hooks or CI from running a deleted ESLint config or accepting malformed or zero-file oxlint scopes.

applicability: Dashboard static linting under dashboard/ and its code-quality scope provenance readers under mcp/test_support/agents_remember_test_support/code_quality/.
conditions: dashboard/.oxlintrc.json disables default categories and enables the 119 mapped active ESLint rules across the four file-group overrides plus the restricted-import guard.
code_quality/scope.py and scope_reporting.py validate positive integer number_of_files and non-empty string diagnostic filenames before reporting distinct files with findings.
exclusions: Type-aware oxlint rules or new lint rules not active in the removed ESLint config.
no-octal across all groups and JS-only no-dupe-args, which are syntax errors in strict ESM and TypeScript.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_code_quality_dashboard_lint_scope.py::test_oxlint_result_files_and_dashboard_lint_scope_line and clean-copy npm run lint (0 warnings, 0 errors across 720 files) and DEP-L6-rule-map.md

mcp/tests/test_code_quality_dashboard_lint_scope.py::test_oxlint_result_files_and_dashboard_lint_scope_line, npm run lint (0 warnings, 0 errors across 722 files including 261124-EXP), and DEP-L6-rule-map.md

statement: Dashboard linting runs on oxlint 1.95.0 with dashboard/.oxlintrc.json carrying 119 of 121 mapped active ESLint rules across all four file groups (only no-octal and JS-only no-dupe-args are absent, both syntax errors in strict ESM and TypeScript), ESLint and its plugins are removed, and code_quality/scope.py and scope_reporting.py read oxlint JSON distinct finding files with unit test coverage.
title: Dashboard lint runs on oxlint with matching rules and JSON scope
